title: Sandbox escape due to incorrect boundary conditions in the WebRTC component
description: A vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-92045 affects Microsoft software version 4.0, involving a sandbox escape due to incorrect boundary conditions in the WebRTC component. This flaw relates to improper handling of memory boundaries, classified under CWE-119. No CVSS score or patch information is currently available, and no known exploits are reported in the wild.
